name: Genovieve
source:
The Magician of November / The Dimension Magician

The Magician of Parilyne's home world, Genovieve is meant to delete Parilyne because of her singularity status. Nova is the one meddling in Genovieve's universe, which forces her to hunt down him and Parilyne.

A fairly small girl with a serious face and presence, Genovieve competently leads her Peacemakers. She insists that Nova's optimism that he can challenge fate and get away with it is foolish. There's a reason why she's so convinced he's wrong...

[From [url=https://toyhou.se/12613764.genovieve]official bio[/url]]
